outro.line: Save this before your next fix

beats.text: Every fix you make breaks my app. Forty users can't log in.
The code isn't the problem. You have no undo.
Step one. Commit before every change.

panel.title: Commit before every change
panel.html:
~/beta-app $ git commit -am "login works"
Claude edits 6 files...
✗ login broken
~/beta-app $ git restore .
✓ back to "login works"

beats.text: Step two. Before I change it, I test what works.

panel.title: Test what works first
panel.html:
> write a test for login. change nothing.
✓ login.test.js passed
fixing the button...
✗ login.test.js failed. Stopped.

beats.text: Now the test complains. Not Maya.
Step three. Plan mode. You see the plan before any edits.

panel.title: Plan before edits
panel.html:
Plan mode: no edits yet
1. Fix button padding
2. Refactor auth.js
✓ Plan updated: button only

beats.text: Wait. Why is login in a button fix?
Step four. Read the diff before you hit accept.

panel.title: Read the diff
panel.html:
src/Button.jsx
- padding: 4px
+ padding: 12px
1 filelogin untouched
Accept
